name: Sai (Eighteen Kingdoms)
alt: Sai, one of the Three Qins

predecessors.name: Qin dynasty
predecessors.text: the Qin heartland given to Sima Xin: 'northeastern Shaanxi' (Eighteen Kingdoms table); 'the lands of the former Qin state in the Guanzhong region' (Sima Xin page)

successors.name: Kingdom of Han (Liu Bang)
successors.text: Sima Xin's kingdom: 'Defeated by Liu Bang' (Eighteen Kingdoms table)

ledger.x: 206: Xiang Yu makes Sima Xin King of Sai.
205: Sima Xin surrenders and Sai passes to Liu Bang.
205: the Kingdom of Sai ends with Sima Xin's surrender.

wars.name: Liu Bang's conquest of the Three Qins
wars.outcome: Liu Bang's army defeated Zhang Han; Sima Xin and Dong Yi surrendered; the Guanzhong became Han's base.

certainty.note: 'Northeastern Shaanxi' is the only description of the land on the table; the Sima Xin page says only 'the Guanzhong region'.
